subject: scipy
read: SciPy's own three-clause BSD text, then the native libraries the wheel bundles (OpenBLAS BSD-3-Clause with its LAPACK, the GCC runtime, libquadmath), each judged by its own scipy.libs row; the vendored sources in the wheel carry their own three-clause BSD notices (scipy/_lib/_uarray/LICENSE, scipy/integrate/LICENSE_DOP, scipy/fft/_duccfft/LICENSE.md). METADATA's License field is the full text and its only classifier the ambiguous BSD one
